easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
